name: 20855 · Derwood, MD
findings: ZIP 20855 (Derwood) has 123 nonprofit organizations. 60 of them (49%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 49 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (19% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 20855 (Derwood) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 20855 (Derwood) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.5 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 49 organizations here; 24% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are groups to join so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
